entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please say 'Support' for product help or 'Sales' to place an order.
Connecting you to the next available agent.
Thank you for calling VeloFit support. My name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Hi... yes, I... I need to return something? My order number is... uh... VF88675.

Okay, I'm pulling up order VF88675 now. I see you purchased a pair of our VeloFit Spin Class Shoes. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with them? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?
I'm not really sure. I wore the cycling shoes to one class and they just... hurt. I think I got blisters. It's all very confusing. The website had so many options.
I'm sorry to hear they weren't comfortable. Sometimes the fit can be tricky. Did you have a chance to adjust the cleats? That can often make a big difference in comfort and prevent blisters.

The cleats? Oh, I don't know anything about that. It all seems so complicated. I just thought they would work. I read the policy online and it confused me. Can't you just help me? I just want a refund.

Of course, I can absolutely help you with that. I understand our policies can seem like a lot to take in. Looking at your order, I can see the shoes were delivered just six days ago, so you are well within our 90-day return window for a full refund.
Oh, really? That's a huge relief. Thank you. I was so worried I was stuck with them.

Not a problem at all. I have just initiated the return for you. I'm sending a prepaid shipping label to the email address on file now. You should see it in the next few minutes. Just pack the shoes up, attach the label, and you can drop them off at any designated shipping point.
Okay, that sounds simple enough. I can do that. Thank you so much, Sarah.
You are very welcome. Once we receive the item back at our warehouse, we'll process your refund to the original payment method. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
No, that was it. Thanks again.
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a wonderful day.
